ANSWERED.LABEL: Answered
ANSWERED.TOOLTIP: Incoming calls you were actually on. Calls you declined are not counted here.

OUTBOUND.LABEL: Outgoing
OUTBOUND.TOOLTIP: Calls you placed in this period.

MISSED.LABEL: Missed
MISSED.TOOLTIP: Calls that rang you and you did not take, either because you declined or because your turn ran out. Calls answered by somebody else before it was your turn are not counted.

MINUTES.LABEL: Minutes on calls
MINUTES.TOOLTIP: Total time you spent talking, across incoming and outgoing calls.

TIME_TO_ANSWER.LABEL: Avg. time to answer
TIME_TO_ANSWER.TOOLTIP: How long you took to pick up, averaged over the calls you answered.

SETUP.TITLE: Make and receive calls in one place
SETUP.SUBTITLE: Set up a voice channel to start handling calls with your team. Every call, along with its recording, will appear here.

ROW.FAILED: This call could not be connected
